Health Connect isn\'t on this phone yet. It\'s free on the Play Store, and Klean keeps its own log either way.
Share sleep and workouts with Health Connect, and bring in nights and workouts from your other apps.
Connected. Nights and workouts from other apps show up here, and Klean\'s workouts go to Health Connect.

Klean reads sleep sessions and workouts so they appear in your log, and writes the workouts you record in Klean. Nothing leaves your phone unless you set up your own sync server, and you can turn access off at any time in Health Connect.
